disposition: research only; no production promotion or end-to-end speedup claim

fixture.kernel_inputs: deterministic synthetic MQ4V2 matrices at real model shapes; seed1; per-slot distinct seed/address/content; input MD5s in raw logs
fixture.roofline_caveat: Not physical DRAM counters, not attainable end-to-end prediction. Excludes KV/state/activations, cache reuse, overfetch and scheduling/compute.

method.route: native HIP event-timed streaming GEMV; not raw PM4
method.headline: median within process; three independent processes and median paired B/A ratio
method.controls: same native AoS kernel/codebytes/input as both arms; three fresh processes
method.parity: all output rows bit-exact for every slot before timing, inverse repack exact; CPUfinite combinedabs1e-5/rel1e-4 reference; RO exactchecksum oracle

interpretation: Global SoA preserves exact weights/output but does not remove logical bytes. Gains are shape-specific: down projection regresses; not a generic bandwidth fix.
No production data layout/loader/prefill/decode change. Shape-specialized savings cannot be summed into an engine speedup without measuring the actual fused path.
Read-only counterfactual was often slower than full GEMV and does not establish a hardware bandwidth floor.
Stock CPU lossless codecs save about7.66% on a bounded real-weight sample; not GPU decoder performance and not full-model compressibility.
gfx1100 FETCH_SIZE and rawGL2C counters returned zero with positive SQ_WAVES; no physical-DRAM claim accepted.

Raw PM4 microbench A/A produced illegal command packet and recovered compute-ring reset. All raw PM4 timings excluded; source code/text/descriptors identical between local/native artifacts. Earlier cross-compiler theory was refuted.
